discoveryMethod: Read-only regex seed discovery of direct EditorWindow, PopupWindowContent, GraphView, CustomEditor and CustomPropertyDrawer declarations and panel/tab name candidates. Runtime visibility and inheritance resolution require a follow-up audit. Direct MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject declarations are seed candidates for default inspectors; abstract types and indirect descendants require resolution.
limitations: Not a compiled semantic inventory or UI traversal
Conditional compilation and indirect inheritance are not resolved
EditorWindow classes include legacy redirects, nested previews and developer-only tools; classify before public navigation
CustomEditor registrations do not enumerate default inspectors, inherited child types, drawers or runtime components
Inline C# layout, loaded resources, fonts, icons and default Unity styles need separate capture
Counts are candidates, not implemented or visually verified surfaces
